title: Let God the Father Live
description: Let God the Father Live in Tonic Solfa to SOUTHWELL, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book III, prepared for the Lord's Supper, hymn 28, headed “1st. S. M”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Short Metre (6.6.8.6). This page sets the words to SOUTHWELL; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Let God the Fa-ther live For ev-er on our tongues; Sin-ners from his first love de-rive The ground of all their songs.

lines: Sinners from his first love derive
The ground of all their songs.
Who bought your souls from hell and death
Whose light and power and grace conveys
O may the blood and water bear
To the great One and Three
That seal this grace in heaven,
The Father, Son, and Spirit, be

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to SOUTHWELL by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
